name: cursor-proximity-glow
title: Cursor Proximity Glow
description: Cursor proximity glow lights up marked elements as the pointer nears them: one document-level pointermove writes per-element --cursor-x/y custom properties and toggles a data attribute, and a pure CSS radial-gradient overlay renders the glow — zero React re-renders on the hot path. Decoration only: touch and keyboard users see resting states with no meaning lost.
